title: My Octopus Teacher: The Greatest Horror Film
summary: Maggie Mae Fish analyzes the documentary My Octopus Teacher as an eco-horror film, critiquing it as a story of a man projecting his own needs onto a wild animal.
why: HN recommends it as a well-done critique of the documentary, sometimes in preference to watching the film itself.

quote.text: I would recommend people not to watch it and instead watch this well done critique (and criticism)
